metrics.label: Trust
metrics.description: Mean of respondents’ trust-composite scores, using the available trust items. Higher values indicate greater agreement.

metrics.label: Adoption intention
metrics.description: Mean of the respondent-level composite for future use, use with access, everyday use, and purchase intention. Higher values indicate stronger intention.

metrics.label: Trip-purpose intention
metrics.description: Mean willingness across commute, business travel, errands, leisure, and vacation purposes. Higher values indicate stronger intention.

metrics.label: Perceived safety
metrics.description: Mean agreement with the item “I would feel safe using the car.” This is a single-item measure, not a multi-item safety composite.

meta.missingValues: Null/non-numeric values excluded from each mean; composite scores retain their precomputed respondent-level item averaging.
